text:
Alex Yang: FYI — acme-corp reported sustained 429 throttles on Dedicated eu-west-2 for ~30m. Symptoms: high latency, repeated KV evictions, and client errors. Tenant: acme-corp. Request IDs: abc123, def456, ghi789.

Maria G: Can you paste the eviction/autoscaler logs and a repro? Are they using very long contexts or concurrent streams?

Alex Yang: Pasting a few log lines we pulled from the dedicated runtime: 
```
2026-03-15T14:22:01Z level=info evict tenant=acme-corp entries=320 size_mb=384 free_mb=12 frag_pct=27 req_id=abc123
2026-03-15T14:22:03Z level=warn kv_pressure tenant=acme-corp eviction_rate=120/s throttled_reqs=45 req_id=def456
2026-03-15T14:22:10Z level=info autoscaler decision=scale_up skipped=cooldown pool=dedicated-eu-west-2 reason=cooldown_remaining=00:09:12
```

Linh Nguyen: frag_pct=27 and free_mb=12 on that pool is bad. Looks like memory fragmentation + sustained long-context workload causing KV churn. The autoscaler log shows it hit cooldown after a previous scale and didn't add capacity during the spike.

Samir Patel: Need repro steps so eng can reproduce. Alex can you share the exact request pattern (concurrency, context length, model)?

Alex Yang: Repro we used to mimic customer: 
1) 8 concurrent reqs from one tenant, each with ~28k tokens context (multi-turn chat)
2) model: redwood-compat-large-quant (pinned)
3) payloads sent every 1s for 20 minutes
Sample curl: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Tenant: acme-corp" -d '{"model":"redwood-compat-large-quant","context_tokens":28000,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}' https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Observed: eviction churn, 429s, then increased tail latency.

Rajiv S: Reproduced in staging. Sequence: eviction spikes, KV cache gets continuously compacted then fragmented, leading to repeated GC-like operations that block token serving. Workaround for now: reduce max context to 8k for the tenant or temporarily increase dedicated pool size. Also add tenant-specific rate-limit to smooth bursts.

Maria G: We should open a support incident and propose immediate mitigations to ACME: 1) temporary pool bump, 2) shorten max_context, 3) disable large-context feature flag if possible. @infra-bot can you apply a manual +2 GPU bump to dedicated-eu-west-2 and set it to expire in 4 hours?

infra-bot: Manual scale initiated. pool=dedicated-eu-west-2 delta=+2 gpus expires=2026-03-16T18:00:00Z reason="support mitigation for acme-corp" action_id=scale-789

support-bot: Created incident: INC-2026-0421 for tenant acme-corp. Assigned to eng-oncall. Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-0421

Linh Nguyen: Short-term config patch we pushed to staging: reduce eviction aggressiveness and increase prefix cache reserved per-tenant. We're testing, but it reduces eviction rate at the cost of higher memory usage. Long-term: implement tenant-weighted eviction and smarter autoscale that factors in KV fragmentation signals.

Samir Patel: Action items: 
- Rajiv: run a controlled canary of the config patch in prod pool and monitor evictions (due EOD).
- Linh: add an autoscaler tweak so it ignores single short cooldowns when KV_pressure > threshold (WIP).
- Maria: draft customer note with mitigations and ETA.

Rajiv S: I can run the canary. Early staging numbers: eviction_rate down ~60%, tail latency down ~30%. Will update metrics dashboard.

Alex Yang: Thanks all. I'll communicate the workaround to the customer: temp pool bump, reduce max_context to 8k, and we will follow up once the canary is validated. Please DM me updates. :thumbsup:

Maria G: Also logging for future RCA: capture per-tenant KV alloc/free histograms, fragmentation over time, autoscaler cooldown events, and per-request token service timings.

infra-bot: Note: manual scale will auto-revert at expiry unless a new action is taken.

Samir Patel: Proposed customer-facing wording (short): "We're seeing KV cache pressure caused by sustained very long-context concurrent requests from your tenant. As an immediate mitigation we've temporarily increased capacity and recommend reducing max context to 8k while we validate a stability patch. We'll follow up with a timeline for a permanent fix."

Rajiv S: I'll open PR for tenant-weighted eviction RFC and link here when ready.

Alex Yang: Closing loop: support incident INC-2026-0421 created, canary patch running, manual scale active. Will post final update in this thread once prod is stable.
